ownerStatement: Add in the settings an option to Skip detailed cleanup review completely have it also work in Expert mode and make sure when it is implemented it gets be only a one click clean up, and everything should work in incognito.
amendmentOwnerStatement: I approve the implemented missing-access flow in which the first SiteWipe activation durably records the reviewed approval and a second SiteWipe activation invokes the browser's exact four-pattern permission prompt and runs the cleanup. Direct cleanup remains default-off, explicitly confirmed, preflight-bound, single-use, and unavailable through any raw cleanup route.
notes: The original 2026-08-20 record approved implementation of the opt-in design without approving an exact public version. The 2026-08-22 amendment authorized the exact 1.11.56 public source-candidate branch and pull request. The owner's 2026-08-23 release-unblock instruction authorizes the exact final forward candidate selected by the integrity process, its branch, push, and pull request after every prerequisite passes; it does not authorize executing merge, tag, binary release, browser-store submission, or promotional publication in this task.

With exact target access pregranted, Clean remains one SiteWipe activation after the setting is enabled. When normal-window target access is missing, activation one durably arms only the reviewed approval and opens or focuses one exact worker-created extension-owned handoff tab without requesting permission or starting cleanup. Activation two occurs only in the bound handoff document: it dispatches authenticated begin, synchronously starts permissions.getAll immediately before permissions.request, and immediately dispatches invocation confirm before awaiting. Only a literal true request paired with a valid pre-request inventory proving no reviewed temporary origin exact- or broad-covered may send the authenticated outcome with preRequestTemporaryOriginsAbsent true. Cleanup requires promptInvocation, that outcome, one exact complete host-only permissions.onAdded event, full authority reconstruction, and exact current grant.

The popup preparation capability and separately minted handoff capability remain document-bound and in-memory only; the raw handoff capability never enters the static URL, browser history, extension storage, a job, report, export, diagnostic, or log. The worker binds only the digest to the exact worker-created tab and worker-resolved TAB context. Direct-open, duplicate, reloaded, navigated, replaced, wrong-frame, wrong-tab, wrong-context, stale, or expired pages cannot continue. Optional MessageSender.documentId is not required and cannot substitute for runtime.getContexts contextId.

The durable arm, begin, invocation, event proof, and outcome proof remain non-runnable until the complete conjunction exists. A true-only record remains pending through bounded resume retries so a delayed exact event may complete exactly once. Review expiry revokes cleanup authority but ordinary in-session expiry and maintenance retain an invoked prompt's exact tombstone and lease while either proof is missing. Complete proof after expiry starts no cleanup, reconciles only the exact temporary patterns, and durably records terminal cancellation before the owned review and lease retire. Only exact terminal handoff settlement or a real browser-session boundary may retire unobserved invoked-prompt bookkeeping. A failed, rejected, malformed, or already-covering pre-request inventory records no outcome and preserves access. Neither resume nor event can synthesize handoff outcome, and handoff outcome cannot synthesize the event.

Permission lease schema 3 records reviewed_prompt_grant ownership only after the complete session invocation, exact onAdded event, literal-true outcome, and pre-request absence proof are durable. Admission upgrades that proof to admitted_cleanup, and release_pending retains it for startup retry. Startup removes only reviewed/admitted owned access; legacy, proofless, and revoked records preserve access. An intersecting permissions.onRemoved event revokes ownership and invalidates pending review authority, so later manual regrant cannot inherit stale cleanup or removal authority.

Private-window operation remains conditional on the browser-controlled Allow in incognito setting. Under the current permission-lease policy, a private-source run requires exact target access before preflight.
The historical false record in complete-review-bypass-approval.json remains unchanged and continues to describe the retired earlier implementation only.

The 2026-08-22 amendment approves the implemented interaction contract for the exact 1.11.56 public source candidate. It does not approve the runtime artifact, claim installed-browser proof, or authorize merge, tag, GitHub Release, store submission, or promotional publication.

The owner's later instructions to make the minimum blocker-clearing changes and necessary monotonic version updates carry the unchanged one-activation-pregranted/two-activation-missing-access consent decision forward to corrective source version 1.11.61. ADR 0013 changes only activation two from the action popup that exact installed 1.11.57 proved nonpersistent to an exact worker-created extension-owned handoff tab; it does not broaden cleanup authority or invent a new owner quotation. Local 1.11.58 was never built or externally used and was superseded only because its first full check exposed transaction-output formatting drift. The first 1.11.59 full suite then exposed only a stale test that named retired popup routes; the current production handoff timeouts were already correct, so the forward 1.11.60 change was test-only. The first 1.11.60 full suite then exposed only test-harness cross-worker pollution from query-imported service-worker copies sharing a later replaceable Chrome mock; production and the assertion body remain unchanged, and the minimal registration-order isolation advances the stable release inputs to 1.11.61.

Exact installed 1.11.61 exposed SW-048: ordinary maintenance forgot an invoked prompt that remained open past review expiry. The 1.11.62 source retained that ownership, forbade expired cleanup, reconciled exact late-granted access only after both proofs, and persisted terminal cancellation before retiring the review and lease.

Exact installed 1.11.62 exposed SW-049: browser-level origin-list storage cleanup follows Chrome's selected-top-level-site partition semantics and cannot preserve a reviewed exact-origin port boundary. The 1.11.63 source keeps the approved activation contract unchanged, adds the required detailed/direct disclosure for registrable-site cleanup, skips browser-level closed-page storage/cache for exact-origin-only scope while retaining exact live-page cleanup and the disclosed host-scoped cookie behavior, and resets an older saved direct opt-in to false so the current material warning must be acknowledged before direct mode is re-enabled.

The owner's 2026-08-23 release-unblock instruction covers the exact final 1.11.63 source-candidate branch push and pull request once their prerequisites pass. This record does not authorize executing merge, tag, GitHub Release, browser-store submission, promotional publication, or a supported binary claim. Exact installed evidence and every later publication action remain separate gates.
